summary.en: The largest city of the ancient Americas, home to perhaps 100,000 people at its height, Teotihuacan dominated central Mexico and projected its power as far as the Maya lowlands. Its rulers are anonymous in its own art; its centre was burned around 550.
summary.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎是古代美洲最大的城市，鼎盛时人口或达10万，支配墨西哥中部，其势力远及玛雅低地。它的统治者在本城艺术中从不留名；城市中心约在550年被焚毁。

name.en: Spearthrower Owl (Jatz'om Kuy), named in Maya inscriptions
name.zh: 投矛器猫头鹰（哈措姆·库伊，见于玛雅铭文）

sources.title: Michael D. Coe & Rex Koontz, Mexico: From the Olmecs to the Aztecs (7th ed., 2013)
UNESCO World Heritage: Pre-Hispanic City of Teotihuacan
Britannica: Teotihuacán

note: No rulers are named in Teotihuacan's own art; the only known name comes from Tikal inscriptions and its identification as a Teotihuacan king is debated. Dates of the city's rise and collapse are approximate.

name.zh: 阿尔班山（萨波特克国家）

summary.en: Built on a levelled mountaintop above the Valley of Oaxaca around 500 BCE, Monte Albán was the capital of a Zapotec state that conquered neighbouring valleys, recorded its victories on carved stones and traded with Teotihuacan, before declining after about 700.
summary.zh: 阿尔班山约在公元前500年建于瓦哈卡谷地上方一座被削平的山顶，是萨波特克国家的都城。这个国家征服了邻近谷地，把胜利刻在石上，并与特奥蒂瓦坎通商，约700年后走向衰落。

sources.title: Michael D. Coe & Rex Koontz, Mexico: From the Olmecs to the Aztecs (7th ed., 2013)
UNESCO World Heritage: Historic Centre of Oaxaca and Archaeological Site of Monte Albán
Joyce Marcus & Kent V. Flannery, Zapotec Civilization (1996)

note: Individual Zapotec rulers of Monte Albán are not known by name with reliable dates; start and end dates are approximate.

summary.en: One of the two superpowers of the Classic Maya world, Tikal had a dynasty of at least 33 kings. A Teotihuacan-backed takeover in 378 began its golden age; defeated by Caracol and Calakmul in the 6th–7th centuries, it recovered under Jasaw Chan K'awiil I.
summary.zh: 蒂卡尔是古典期玛雅世界的两大强国之一，王朝至少有33位国王。378年由特奥蒂瓦坎支持的政权更迭开启了它的黄金时代；6至7世纪它先后败于卡拉科尔和卡拉克穆尔，在哈索·钱·卡威尔一世治下重新崛起。

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
Robert J. Sharer & Loa P. Traxler, The Ancient Maya (6th ed., 2006)
UNESCO World Heritage: Tikal National Park

note: Yax Ehb Xook's reign (c. 90) is inferred from later king lists.

capital.zh: 齐班切，约635年起为卡拉克穆尔

summary.en: The Snake-head (Kaanul) dynasty built the most extensive network of vassal kingdoms in the Classic Maya world. From Dzibanché and later Calakmul it encircled and defeated Tikal in 562, but lost its hegemony after Tikal's victory in 695.
summary.zh: 蛇头（卡阿努尔）王朝建立了古典期玛雅世界最庞大的附庸王国网络。它先后以齐班切和卡拉克穆尔为都，562年包围并击败蒂卡尔，但在695年蒂卡尔获胜后失去霸权。

name.zh: 尤克努姆·奇恩二世（大帝）

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
UNESCO World Heritage: Ancient Maya City and Protected Tropical Forests of Calakmul
Simon Martin, Ancient Maya Politics (2020)

note: The early dynasty's dates and the date of the move to Calakmul are uncertain.

summary.en: The kingdom of Baakal, "Bone", ruled from Palenque in the western Maya lowlands. Twice sacked by Calakmul, it reached its height under Pakal the Great and his sons, whose tombs and inscriptions are among the richest Maya texts.
summary.zh: 巴卡尔王国意为“骨”，以玛雅低地西部的帕伦克为都。它曾两度遭卡拉克穆尔洗劫，在巴加尔大帝及其儿子们治下达到鼎盛，他们的陵墓和铭文是最丰富的玛雅文献之一。

name.zh: 库克·巴拉姆一世（开国者）
基尼奇·哈纳布·巴加尔一世
基尼奇·坎·霍伊·奇塔姆二世
基尼奇·阿卡尔·莫·纳布三世

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
UNESCO World Heritage: Pre-Hispanic City and National Park of Palenque

summary.en: Founded by the outsider Yax K'uk' Mo' in 426, the Copán dynasty ruled the southeastern edge of the Maya world for sixteen reigns. Its sculpture and the Hieroglyphic Stairway are its glory; its 13th king was captured and beheaded by Quiriguá in 738.
summary.zh: 科潘王朝由外来者亚什·库克·莫于426年建立，统治玛雅世界的东南边缘，历经十六位国王。雕刻和象形文字阶梯是它的荣耀；第十三代国王于738年被基里瓜俘虏并斩首。

name.zh: 基尼奇·亚什·库克·莫（开国者）
卡克·乌提·维茨·卡威尔（烟伊米希）
瓦沙克拉胡恩·乌巴·卡威尔（十八兔）
卡克·霍普拉赫·钱·卡威尔
卡克·伊普亚赫·钱·卡威尔

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
Robert J. Sharer & Loa P. Traxler, The Ancient Maya (6th ed., 2006)
UNESCO World Heritage: Maya Site of Copan

summary.en: A Maya kingdom in the Maya Mountains of present-day Belize, Caracol allied with Calakmul and defeated Tikal in 562, then grew into one of the largest Classic cities, with extensive agricultural terraces and causeways.
summary.zh: 卡拉科尔是位于今伯利兹玛雅山区的玛雅王国，与卡拉克穆尔结盟，于562年击败蒂卡尔，随后发展为古典期最大的城市之一，拥有大片农业梯田和堤道。

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
Arlen F. Chase & Diane Z. Chase, Caracol Archaeological Project
Wikipedia: Caracol

note: The founder's date is retrospective; the end date marks the city's abandonment.

summary.en: Set in a loop of the Usumacinta River, Yaxchilan was the seat of the Bahlam (Jaguar) dynasty, famous for carved lintels showing royal bloodletting and warfare, and the long rival of Piedras Negras.
summary.zh: 亚斯奇兰坐落在乌苏马辛塔河的一处河湾中，是巴拉姆（美洲豹）王朝的王都，以描绘王室放血仪式和战争的雕刻门楣闻名，长期与彼德拉斯内格拉斯为敌。

name.en: Itzamnaaj Bahlam III (Shield Jaguar the Great)
name.zh: 伊察姆纳赫·巴拉姆三世（大盾豹）
亚孙·巴拉姆四世（鸟豹四世）
伊察姆纳赫·巴拉姆四世
基尼奇·塔特布·骷髅三世

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Yaxchilán"
Wikipedia: Yaxchilan

note: The founding date of 359 is retrospective; the ten-year gap after 742 may have been an interregnum.

summary.en: Founded as a Tikal outpost in the Petexbatún region, Dos Pilas broke away under a Tikal prince who sided with Calakmul. It became an aggressive regional power until it was overrun in 761 and its people fled behind hastily built walls.
summary.zh: 多斯皮拉斯原是蒂卡尔在佩特斯巴顿地区设立的前哨，在一位投靠卡拉克穆尔的蒂卡尔王子治下脱离而去，成为咄咄逼人的地区强国，直到761年被攻陷，居民逃到仓促筑起的城墙之后。

sources.title: Simon Martin & Nikolai Grube, Chronicle of the Maya Kings and Queens (2nd ed., 2008)
Arthur A. Demarest, The Petexbatun Regional Archaeological Project (2006)
Wikipedia: Dos Pilas

summary.en: Chichen Itza dominated northern Yucatán in the Terminal Classic and Early Postclassic, mixing Maya and central Mexican styles. It may have been governed by a council rather than a single divine king, and its influence faded in the 12th–13th centuries.
summary.zh: 奇琴伊察在古典期末期至后古典期早期支配尤卡坦北部，融合了玛雅和墨西哥中部的风格。它可能由议事会而非单一的神圣国王统治，其影响力在12至13世纪逐渐衰退。

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage: Pre-Hispanic City of Chichen-Itza
Michael D. Coe & Rex Koontz, Mexico: From the Olmecs to the Aztecs (7th ed., 2013)
Robert J. Sharer & Loa P. Traxler, The Ancient Maya (6th ed., 2006)

note: The chronology of Chichen Itza is much debated; K'ak'upakal is the only well-attested ruler name, and its political structure is uncertain.

summary.en: From Tula in Hidalgo, the Toltecs dominated central Mexico in the Early Postclassic. Later Aztec tradition remembered them as master craftsmen and the source of legitimate rule; the traditional date of Tula's fall is 1168.
summary.zh: 托尔特克人以伊达尔戈州的图拉为中心，在后古典期早期支配墨西哥中部。后来的阿兹特克传统把他们追忆为技艺超群的工匠和正统王权的源头；图拉陷落的传统年份为1168年。

name.zh: 塞·阿卡特尔·托皮尔钦·克察尔科亚特尔（传说）
韦马克（传说中的末代国王）

sources.title: Michael D. Coe & Rex Koontz, Mexico: From the Olmecs to the Aztecs (7th ed., 2013)
Nigel Davies, The Toltecs until the Fall of Tula (1977)
Britannica: Toltec

note: Legend: rulers and their dates come from post-conquest chronicles such as the Annals of Cuauhtitlan and vary between sources.

summary.en: A Mixtec kingdom on the Pacific coast of Oaxaca founded, according to the codices, by Lord Eight Deer Jaguar Claw. It conquered much of the coast, resisted the Aztecs and submitted to Pedro de Alvarado in 1522.
summary.zh: 图图特佩克是瓦哈卡太平洋沿岸的米斯特克王国，据古抄本记载由八鹿·美洲豹爪领主建立。它征服了大片海岸，抵挡住了阿兹特克人，1522年向佩德罗·德阿尔瓦拉多投降。

sources.title: Maarten Jansen & Gabina Aurora Pérez Jiménez, The Mixtec Pictorial Manuscripts (2011)
Michael D. Coe & Rex Koontz, Mexico: From the Olmecs to the Aztecs (7th ed., 2013)
Wikipedia: Tututepec

note: Dates derive from the Mixtec codices and their correlation with the European calendar.

summary.en: A walled city of some 15,000 people, Mayapan was the political capital of northern Yucatán in the Late Postclassic, governed by a confederacy of noble lineages under the Cocom. A Xiu-led revolt destroyed it around 1441, splitting the peninsula into rival provinces.
summary.zh: 玛雅潘是一座约有1.5万人口的城墙环绕的城市，在后古典期晚期是尤卡坦北部的政治中心，由科科姆家族领导的贵族宗族联盟统治。约1441年修家族领导的叛乱摧毁了它，半岛随之分裂为相互敌对的诸省。

sources.title: Marilyn A. Masson & Carlos Peraza Lope, Kukulcan's Realm: Urban Life at Ancient Mayapán (2014)
Robert J. Sharer & Loa P. Traxler, The Ancient Maya (6th ed., 2006)
Wikipedia: Mayapan

note: No individual rulers are known with reliable dates; the founding and fall dates come from the Books of Chilam Balam and archaeology.

summary.en: The K'iche' Maya built the strongest kingdom of the Guatemalan highlands, ruled from the fortified capital of Q'umarkaj. Under K'iq'ab it reached the Pacific coast; it was conquered by Pedro de Alvarado in 1524.
summary.zh: 基切玛雅人建立了危地马拉高地最强大的王国，以设防的都城库马尔卡赫为中心。在基卡布治下，它的疆域扩展到太平洋沿岸；1524年被佩德罗·德阿尔瓦拉多征服。

sources.title: Robert M. Carmack, The Quiché Mayas of Utatlán (1981)
Robert J. Sharer & Loa P. Traxler, The Ancient Maya (6th ed., 2006)
Wikipedia: Kʼicheʼ kingdom of Qʼumarkaj

note: Reign dates are approximate, reconstructed from the Popol Vuh and the Título de Totonicapán.

name.zh: 特帕内克国家（阿斯卡波察尔科）

summary.en: From Azcapotzalco on the western shore of Lake Texcoco, the Tepanecs built the dominant empire of the Valley of Mexico in the late 14th century, with the Mexica of Tenochtitlan as their tributaries and mercenaries, until the Triple Alliance destroyed them in 1428.
summary.zh: 特帕内克人以特斯科科湖西岸的阿斯卡波察尔科为中心，在14世纪后期建立了墨西哥谷地占支配地位的帝国，特诺奇蒂特兰的墨西加人是他们的纳贡者和雇佣兵，直到1428年被三方同盟消灭。

sources.title: Michael E. Smith, The Aztecs (3rd ed., 2012)
Ross Hassig, Aztec Warfare: Imperial Expansion and Political Control (1988)
Wikipedia: Tepanec

note: The start date is approximate.

name.zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰墨西加城邦

summary.en: The Mexica city-state founded on an island in Lake Texcoco was a tributary of Azcapotzalco under its first rulers. After 1428 its tlatoani led the Triple Alliance (see that polity for the imperial rulers); the city fell to the Spanish in 1521.
summary.zh: 墨西加人在特斯科科湖岛上建立的城邦，在最初几位统治者时期是阿斯卡波察尔科的附庸。1428年后，它的特拉托阿尼领导三方同盟（帝国时期的统治者见该条目）；1521年该城陷于西班牙人之手。

sources.title: Michael E. Smith, The Aztecs (3rd ed., 2012)
Susan D. Gillespie, The Aztec Kings: The Construction of Rulership in Mexica History (1989)
Britannica: Tenochtitlán

note: Founding in 1325 and early reign dates follow Mexica annals, which differ by a few years.

summary.en: Formed in 1428 by Tenochtitlan, Texcoco and Tlacopan to overthrow Azcapotzalco, the alliance built the Aztec empire, a tribute network of some 38 provinces stretching from the Gulf to the Pacific, until its destruction by the Spanish and their Indigenous allies.
summary.zh: 三方同盟由特诺奇蒂特兰、特斯科科和特拉科潘于1428年结成，以推翻阿斯卡波察尔科。它建立了阿兹特克帝国，即一个由约38个省组成、从墨西哥湾延伸到太平洋的纳贡网络，直到被西班牙人及其原住民盟友摧毁。

sources.title: Michael E. Smith, The Aztecs (3rd ed., 2012)
Michael D. Coe & Rex Koontz, Mexico: From the Olmecs to the Aztecs (7th ed., 2013)
Britannica: Aztec

note: Rulers listed are the huey tlatoani of Tenochtitlan, who led the alliance.

name.zh: 特斯科科阿科尔瓦王国

summary.en: The Acolhua capital on the eastern shore of the lake, Texcoco was the second partner of the Triple Alliance and the cultural centre of the Nahua world, famous for its laws, archives, gardens and the poetry of Nezahualcoyotl.
summary.zh: 特斯科科是湖东岸的阿科尔瓦都城，三方同盟的第二大成员，也是纳瓦世界的文化中心，以法律、档案、园林和内萨瓦尔科约特尔的诗歌闻名。

name.zh: 伊斯特利尔索奇特尔一世

sources.title: Michael E. Smith, The Aztecs (3rd ed., 2012)
Jerome A. Offner, Law and Politics in Aztec Texcoco (1983)
Wikipedia: Tetzcoco (altepetl)

note: The start date and early reign dates are approximate.

summary.en: The Purépecha (Tarascan) kingdom of Michoacán, centred on Lake Pátzcuaro, was the second-largest state in Mesoamerica and the only one the Aztecs never conquered. Its metalworkers made bronze tools. It submitted to the Spanish in 1522 and its last king was executed in 1530.
summary.zh: 米却肯的普雷佩查（塔拉斯坎）王国以帕茨夸罗湖为中心，是中美洲第二大国家，也是阿兹特克人唯一未能征服的国家。它的金属匠人能制造青铜工具。1522年它臣服于西班牙人，末代国王于1530年被处决。

sources.title: Helen Perlstein Pollard, Taríacuri's Legacy: The Prehispanic Tarascan State (1993)
Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Tarascan"
Wikipedia: Purépecha Empire

note: Early reign dates are approximate; they derive from the Relación de Michoacán.

name.zh: 伊斯帕尼奥拉岛泰诺酋邦

capital.en: Several cacicazgos (Marién, Maguá, Maguana, Jaragua, Higüey)
capital.zh: 多个酋邦（马连、马瓜、马瓜纳、哈拉瓜、伊圭）

summary.en: When Columbus arrived, Hispaniola was divided among five major Taíno chiefdoms led by caciques, with ball courts, ceremonial plazas and a rich cult of zemis. They were destroyed within a generation by war, forced labour and disease; Enriquillo's peace of 1533 marked the end.
summary.zh: 哥伦布到来时，伊斯帕尼奥拉岛被五个主要的泰诺酋邦瓜分，由酋长统领，拥有球场、祭祀广场和丰富的泽米神灵崇拜。它们在一代人的时间里因战争、强迫劳动和疾病而灭亡；1533年恩里基约的和约标志着终结。

sources.title: Irving Rouse, The Tainos: Rise and Decline of the People Who Greeted Columbus (1992)
Samuel M. Wilson, Hispaniola: Caribbean Chiefdoms in the Age of Columbus (1990)
Britannica: Taino

note: The start date is an approximation for the emergence of classic Taíno chiefdoms; Hatuey ruled in Hispaniola before leading resistance in Cuba.

summary.en: Spain's richest American realm, governed by viceroys from Mexico City, stretched from California and Texas to Central America, the Caribbean and, across the Pacific, the Philippines. Silver from Zacatecas and Guanajuato flowed to Europe and China.
summary.zh: 新西班牙是西班牙在美洲最富庶的领地，由驻墨西哥城的总督统治，疆域从加利福尼亚和得克萨斯延伸到中美洲、加勒比地区，并越过太平洋直达菲律宾。萨卡特卡斯和瓜纳华托的白银源源不断地流向欧洲和中国。

name.zh: 马丁·恩里克斯·德阿尔曼萨
胡安·德帕拉福克斯-门多萨

name.en: Juan Vicente de Güemes, 2nd Count of Revillagigedo
name.zh: 第二代雷维利亚希赫多伯爵胡安·比森特·德格梅斯

sources.title: Brian R. Hamnett, A Concise History of Mexico (3rd ed., 2019)
Charles Gibson, Spain in America (1966)
Britannica: New Spain

note: Cortés governed from 1521, but the viceroyalty was created in 1535.

name.en: Captaincy General of Guatemala (Kingdom of Guatemala)
name.zh: 危地马拉都督辖区（危地马拉王国）

capital.en: Santiago de los Caballeros; Guatemala City from 1776
capital.zh: 圣地亚哥-德洛斯卡瓦列罗斯；1776年起为危地马拉城

summary.en: A semi-autonomous part of New Spain covering Chiapas and Central America from Guatemala to Costa Rica, ruled by a president-captain general and the Audiencia. Its capital was moved after the 1773 earthquakes; it declared independence in 1821.
summary.zh: 危地马拉都督辖区是新西班牙的半自治部分，涵盖恰帕斯以及从危地马拉到哥斯达黎加的中美洲，由检审庭庭长兼都督和检审法院治理。1773年地震后首府迁移；1821年宣布独立。

name.zh: 佩德罗·德阿尔瓦拉多（总督）
阿隆索·洛佩斯·德塞拉托

sources.title: Ralph Lee Woodward Jr., Central America: A Nation Divided (3rd ed., 1999)
Britannica: Guatemala: Colonial period
Wikipedia: Captaincy General of Guatemala

note: Alvarado governed before the Audiencia was created in 1542.

capital.zh: 法兰西角；1770年起为太子港

summary.en: The western third of Hispaniola, ceded to France by Spain at Ryswick in 1697, became the world's richest colony, producing much of Europe's sugar and coffee with the labour of nearly half a million enslaved Africans, until the revolution that created Haiti.
summary.zh: 伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西部三分之一的土地于1697年在里斯维克被西班牙割让给法国，后来成为世界上最富庶的殖民地，依靠近50万非洲奴隶的劳动生产欧洲大部分的蔗糖和咖啡，直到催生海地的革命爆发。

sources.title: Laurent Dubois, Avengers of the New World: The Story of the Haitian Revolution (2004)
Britannica: Saint-Domingue
Wikipedia: Saint-Domingue

note: French buccaneers settled from the 1620s–1660s; formal sovereignty dates from the Treaty of Ryswick (1697).

name.zh: 西属古巴（古巴都督辖区）

capital.zh: 圣地亚哥-德古巴；1607年起为哈瓦那

summary.en: Conquered from 1511, Cuba was first a base for conquest and the treasure fleets, then, after the Haitian Revolution, the world's largest sugar producer, worked by enslaved Africans until 1886. Spain lost it in 1898.
summary.zh: 古巴自1511年起被征服，最初是征服行动和运宝船队的基地；海地革命后成为世界最大的蔗糖产地，依靠非洲奴隶劳动直到1886年。西班牙于1898年失去古巴。

name.zh: 迭戈·贝拉斯克斯·德奎利亚尔

sources.title: Louis A. Pérez Jr., Cuba: Between Reform and Revolution (5th ed., 2015)
Hugh Thomas, Cuba: The Pursuit of Freedom (1971; updated 1998)
Britannica: Cuba: History

note: The captaincy general proper dates from 1607; earlier governors are included for continuity.

summary.en: The first Black republic and the second independent state in the Americas, born from the only successful slave revolution in history. It was split between Christophe's northern kingdom and Pétion's southern republic until 1820, ruled Santo Domingo in 1822–1844, was occupied by the United States in 1915–1934 and ruled by the Duvaliers in 1957–1986.
summary.zh: 海地是第一个黑人共和国，也是美洲第二个独立国家，诞生于历史上唯一一次成功的奴隶革命。1820年以前它分裂为克里斯托夫的北方王国和佩蒂翁的南方共和国，1822至1844年统治圣多明各，1915至1934年被美国占领，1957至1986年由杜瓦利埃父子统治。

summary.en: Independent Mexico began as a constitutional monarchy under the Plan of Iguala, reaching from Oregon country to Costa Rica. When no European prince accepted the throne, Agustín de Iturbide was proclaimed emperor in 1822; he abdicated in 1823 and Central America broke away.
summary.zh: 独立的墨西哥依照《伊瓜拉计划》以君主立宪国起步，疆域从俄勒冈地区延伸到哥斯达黎加。由于没有欧洲王子接受王位，阿古斯丁·德伊图尔比德于1822年被拥立为皇帝；1823年他退位，中美洲随之分离。

note: The empire dates from the Declaration of Independence of 28 September 1821; Iturbide was crowned in 1822.

summary.en: The Mexican republic lost half its territory to the United States in 1848, survived civil war and French intervention under Juárez, was modernised under Díaz, remade by the Revolution of 1910–1920, governed by one party (the PRI) for 71 years until 2000, and elected its first woman president in 2024.
summary.zh: 墨西哥共和国于1848年把一半领土丧失给美国，在华雷斯领导下挺过内战和法国干涉，在迪亚斯治下实现现代化，又经1910至1920年的革命重塑，此后由一个政党（革命制度党）执政71年直至2000年，并于2024年选出首位女总统。

summary.en: A monarchy installed by Napoleon III's army with Mexican conservative support, under the Habsburg archduke Maximilian. It never controlled the whole country, collapsed when French troops withdrew under US pressure, and ended with Maximilian's execution at Querétaro.
summary.zh: 第二墨西哥帝国是拿破仑三世的军队在墨西哥保守派支持下扶植的君主国，由哈布斯堡大公马克西米连统治。它从未控制全国，法军在美国压力下撤离后便告崩溃，以马克西米连在克雷塔罗被处决告终。

summary.en: After leaving Iturbide's empire, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua and Costa Rica formed a federation. Torn between liberals and conservatives, it fought civil wars, lost member states from 1838 and was dissolved by 1841.
summary.zh: 脱离伊图尔比德的帝国后，危地马拉、萨尔瓦多、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜和哥斯达黎加组成联邦。它在自由派与保守派之间撕裂，内战不断，自1838年起成员国相继退出，至1841年解体。

summary.en: Independent from the federation and proclaimed a republic in 1847, Guatemala was long ruled by caudillos and coffee planters. The "ten years of spring" (1944–1954) ended in a US-backed coup, followed by a civil war (1960–1996) in which state forces committed genocide against the Maya.
summary.zh: 危地马拉脱离联邦后于1847年宣布成立共和国，长期由考迪罗和咖啡种植园主统治。“十年之春”（1944—1954年）以美国支持的政变告终，随后爆发内战（1960—1996年），国家军队在其间对玛雅人犯下种族灭绝罪行。

summary.en: The Dominican Republic won independence from Haiti in 1844, returned briefly to Spanish rule in 1861–1865, was occupied by the United States in 1916–1924 and endured the 31-year dictatorship of Rafael Trujillo. Since 1978 power has changed hands through elections.
summary.zh: 多米尼加共和国于1844年脱离海地独立，1861至1865年短暂回归西班牙统治，1916至1924年被美国占领，并经历了拉斐尔·特鲁希略长达31年的独裁。自1978年以来，政权通过选举更替。

sources.title: Frank Moya Pons, The Dominican Republic: A National History (3rd ed., 2010)
Britannica: Dominican Republic: History
Wikipedia: History of the Dominican Republic

note: Trujillo ruled directly or through puppet presidents from 1930 to 1961; Balaguer also served in 1960–1962 and 1986–1996.

summary.en: Independent after US occupation, but bound by the Platt Amendment until 1934, the Cuban republic passed through dictatorships under Machado and Batista. The revolution of 1959 created a one-party socialist state led by Fidel and then Raúl Castro.
summary.zh: 古巴共和国在美国占领结束后独立，但直到1934年都受《普拉特修正案》约束，先后经历马查多和巴蒂斯塔的独裁。1959年革命建立了由菲德尔·卡斯特罗及后来的劳尔·卡斯特罗领导的一党社会主义国家。

name.zh: 托马斯·埃斯特拉达·帕尔马

summary.en: Panama seceded from Colombia in 1903 with US backing and granted the United States the Canal Zone. Military rule under Torrijos and Noriega lasted from 1968 to the US invasion of 1989; the canal passed to Panama on 31 December 1999.
summary.zh: 巴拿马于1903年在美国支持下脱离哥伦比亚，并把运河区交给美国。托里霍斯和诺列加的军人统治从1968年持续到1989年美国入侵；1999年12月31日运河移交巴拿马。
